theme: The Denial Came First - Volume II
title: Out of Jurisdiction
next: Next: I’ll get back to you.

scenes.text: The incident happened in another country. Therefore: not our department. Case closed.
Then, after months, one question: was the ticket bought in this country? He said yes. In the correspondence on file, that’s where the replies stop.
Jurisdiction is a lovely word. It means the problem has a postcode, and it isn’t ours.
